title: Notice Regarding Commencement of New Semester and Transport Service
text:
As per the Academic Calendar, all examinations have been completed, and classes for the new semester will resume on
9th February 2026
.

All students are advised to complete their registration for the new semester before the commencement of classes to avoid any inconvenience.

It is further informed that the University transport (route service) will not be available from tomorrow and will resume on
9th February 2026
, coinciding with the start of the new semester.

Ibrar Hussain Umerzai

Director Transport

Member Syndicate
